facades.name: Facades: Grammar Builds Architecture
facades.truth: A wall is never just a wall. Every facade negotiates inside and outside.
facades.qfep_connection: Facades sit at the boundary between public and private, ornament and structure, inside and outside. Each architectural order is a grammar (F) that generates infinite variation (E). The facade is where identity meets the world -- the lambda parameter is the degree of openness.
facades.description: From a plain wall, architecture grows. Facades are grammar systems that compose base, wall, columns, openings, and crown into coherent wholes. Start with horizontal zoning, learn rhythm through columns, master the classical orders, punctuate with windows and doors, study Italian presets, then compose your own.
learning_objectives: Openings as negative space and hierarchy
Free-form facade composition as creative synthesis
content: Facade_Wall_Basics: Horizontal Zones — base, wall, cornice. The simplest facade grammar.
Facade_Columns_Rhythm: Columns and Rhythm — Columns create rhythm. Bay divisions and bilateral symmetry.
Facade_Classical_Orders: Classical Orders — proportional systems evolve.
Facade_Windows_Doors: Openings and Thresholds — Openings negotiate inside/outside. Framing and hierarchy.
Facade_Italian_Presets: Italian Presets — Full facades from the Italian study pack. Cultural grammar.
Facade_Custom_Composition: Your Facade — Your facade. Free-form builder with all elements available.

key_texts: Summerson: The Classical Language of Architecture
Ching: Architecture: Form, Space, and Order

artifact_groups.rationale: Horizontal zoning: base, wall, cornice. The simplest facade grammar — three horizontal bands that every building negotiates. Grammar demo shows compositional rules.
Columns create rhythm: bay divisions and bilateral symmetry. Grammar demo shifts to vertical subdivision — the interplay of repetition and variation.
Tuscan, Doric, Ionic, Corinthian: proportional systems that evolved over centuries. Grammar demo cycles through classical orders as parametric variation.
Openings negotiate inside and outside: windows as negative space, doors as threshold hierarchy. Grammar demo shows framing, proportion, and placement rules.
Full facades from the Italian study pack: Neapolitan palazzo, Roman baroque, Venetian Gothic. Grammar demo assembles complete cultural vocabularies.
Free-form composition: facade builder with all elements available alongside grammar demo reference. Players compose their own architectural grammar from learned vocabulary.
